product_updates.title: Stability AI, maker of image generator Stable Diffusion, raises $76 million in fresh funding
product_updates.content: The company's new fundraising total now stands at $232 million.

product_updates.title: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
product_updates.content: Anthropic is giving Claude a shared memory across chat and Cowork, so users no longer have to repeatedly brief the AI on projects, preferences, and other context.

product_updates.title: Gamma acquires Accel-backed design startup Lica
product_updates.content: Lica co-founders are going to work on Gamma's new research team.

product_updates.title: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip is built for fast inference at scale, benchmarks show
product_updates.content: Tested on SemiAnalysis’ InferenceX benchmark, Jalapeño registered both more tokens per user and more throughput per kilowatt than the currently available state-of-the art.

product_updates.title: Accel-backed Keenable is indexing the web for AI agents
product_updates.content: Now exiting stealth mode with a $26 million seed round, Keenable has been building a vast web search index for AI agents.

product_updates.title: ‘The world seems to be ready’: An interview with OpenAI head of product Thibault Sottiaux
product_updates.content: TechCrunch talks agents, UX, and reporting to Greg Brockman with OpenAI's head of product.

product_updates.title: Situational Awareness, star AI hedge fund that nearly imploded, now being probed by the SEC
product_updates.content: The AI hedge fund went from "the talk of Wall Street" to "subject of federal subpoenas" faster than you can say "diversify your portfolio."
